text: {"lessons":["A few periods are too short to judge whether my approach beats the market; I should evaluate results over longer horizons and compare them with a suitable benchmark.","Avoid making repeated trades from short-term price moves alone: set a clear reason and time horizon for each trade, and account for how buys and sells change my overall exposure.","Selling at a loss or taking a gain is not itself proof a trade was right or wrong; review the original thesis and manage position sizes and risk consistently."]}
